flags.message: Conditioning note, not a defect: the docket shows the Court requested a response on Jul 30 2026 after the City waived, and the petition was pulled from the 9/28/2026 conference pending a BIO now due Oct 30 2026. The frozen context records band=baseline, distribution_count=1 and response_requested=null, so the scored baseline (~5% pooled reached rate for baseline) does not reflect the call-for-response signal. My P(grant)=0.30 adjusts for it; the gap between the two is the CFR, not a disagreement about the band.

documents.json marks petition.txt truncated (286 pages, the petition plus Appendix Volume I). The petition body itself (through the Conclusion) is intact; only appendix material is cut, and no BIO exists yet to provision. No effect on the forecast.
